name: Innocent
overview: Scripture highlights the value of innocence as a reflection of purity and righteousness before God, emphasizing the protection and deliverance of the innocent through the purity of one’s hands (Job 22:30). Believers are called to embody harmlessness and wisdom, being simple as doves amidst a hostile world (Matthew 10:16), while maintaining a life unspotted from worldly corruption (James 1:27). The topic also includes the serious sin of killing the innocent, underscoring God's hatred for such abominations (Proverbs 6:16). Christians are encouraged to actively work out their salvation with reverence and self-discipline, reflecting the inward purity that honors God (Philippians 2:12).
